scripts.build: bun run --filter backend build && bun run --filter frontend build
scripts.test:db:setup: cd backend && bunx dotenv -e .env.test -- bunx prisma migrate deploy && bunx dotenv -e .env.test -- tsx prisma/seed.ts
scripts.test:db:reset: cd backend && bunx dotenv -e .env.test -- bunx prisma migrate reset --force --skip-seed
